{{Quote|Oh, come on, Chewie. We've gotten into more heavily guarded places than that—''"<br />"''Frowh rahgh rahrahraff vrawgh gr.''"<br />"''Well, the spice vaults of Gargon, for one.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="Return of the Jedi">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novel]]</ref>}}
The '''spice vaults of Gargon'''<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> were huge, well-guarded vaults located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gargon/Legends|Gargon]]. They belonged to a notorius [[Unidentified gangster (Gargon)|gangster]] that used the facilities to store a hoard of [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="Second Edition" />
